about: Source registry. Audited 11 Nov 2026 and re-audited 15 Nov 2026 under D-77: robots.txt, terms, listing URL pattern and days ahead for each source, from one manual request per page. Only status 'cleared' sources run on a schedule (D-77). Format: docs/DATA.md.

sources.name: Lagocine

terms.quote: No terms link on the home page; only /privacy/.

permission.summary: Asked by email to contact@lagocine.com from Chimezie on 11 Nov 2026. Paul Sergent replied the same day: "you can use it freely as much as you want", asking for a link on every page; Chime chose to credit Lagocine with a link on the About page instead (D-130, D-132).

sources.notes: D-76 (15 Nov 2026): fallback only, for each cinema we cannot read directly yet; a cinema leaves this list the day its own reader is built and cleared (Genesis and Silverbird Ikeja are cleared on 15 Nov but have no reader yet, so they stay until theirs runs). Filmhouse's 7 stay on it for the long run, because Filmhouse's ticketing provider (CINEsync) answers our named bot with 403 Access Denied. Booking links still go to Filmhouse's own site, never to Lagocine (it now sells tickets: "Lagocine sells this ticket on its own site", 15 Nov). To be credited on /about and on each cinema page it feeds (not built yet). Its own "last read" time sets the showings' age. Dropped for any cinema the day we can read that cinema directly. Earlier: Preferred source if it agrees (D-07). Says it reads each cinema's own pages daily, sells nothing, takes no commission. 11 Nov: home page is static HTML (build stamp lagocine-built 2026-11-11T00:05:05+01:00). Still needs permission: robots allowing crawling is not a licence to republish (PRD). Audit: cinema and day pages are static HTML with the times in the page. The sitemap lists day pages for today plus six days and some December dates; the Silverbird Ikeja page carried a full programme for today and tomorrow only. No fixture committed: waiting for the reply to the 11 Nov email. D-33 (11 Nov): becomes the live source on Day 6 with full credit unless it objects first; status stays pending until Chime confirms cleared that day. 17 Nov 2026 (D-122): Genesis's three Lagos cinemas, Silverbird Ikeja, Grand and Blue Pictures left this list, read from their own sites now. It still feeds Filmhouse's 7 (CINEsync 403), Filmworld (its Veezi page showed no shows while Lagocine listed 22 times) and the script-built sites whose readers come next (EbonyLife, Ozone, Sky, Viva, THC, Magnificent). 17 Nov 2026 (D-125): EbonyLife, Ozone, Sky, Viva, THC and Magnificent left this list (14 → 8), read from their own script-built sites now. It feeds Filmhouse's 7 (CINEsync 403) and Filmworld (its Veezi page still showed no shows at 02:52).

sources.notes: D-131 (17 Nov 2026): a stopgap while Filmhouse's times can't be read. One request a run to the public home page, which answers our named bot with 200 (robots.txt allows /; it disallows /api/ and every /select-tickets page, which we never fetch). Its "Now Showing" list is empty in the HTML: the browser fills it from filmhouseng.api.cinesync.io, the CINEsync host that refuses our bot (403), so we never call it (D-77). What the page itself carries is its banner's data: 9 films on 17 Nov, each with runtime, rating and the nearest date it has showtimes (its is_coming_soon flag was false for all 9, Avengers: Doomsday included, so it is not used). A film whose nearest date is today in Lagos is featured today: 4 on 17 Nov (Ghost Soldier, How to Rob a Bank, Five Figurines, Dear Ajayi). The banner is a promotion, not the whole programme, and it is for every location ("All"), so the site says "Filmhouse's home page features ... today", never "Filmhouse is showing", never "and N more", never per cinema. Feeds no showings (`cinemaIds` is empty), only the featured films for the cinemas in `featuredFor`, shown only on those with no times (Lagocine's times win). The filmhouse entry stays pending and Lagocine stays the source of Filmhouse's times.

No fixture committed. 17 Nov 2026 (D-120): Ceddi Plaza, Abuja added to cinemaIds. 17 Nov 2026 (D-122): read live by scripts/sources/genesis.ts: each location page in cinemaPages (today's programme, dated, 24-hour clock), then one film page per film on at any of them (/<site>/film/<id>/<slug>: that film at every Genesis location for three days), at most 30 a run. All four left (or never joined) Lagocine. 17 Nov 2026 (D-124): bookingSites gives each cinema's name in the booking links (Lekki's page is freedom-way-lekki/ but its links say lekki-purple), so a location with nothing on today keeps its tomorrow; a film page that answers 404/410 or times out is skipped with a log line, a refusal (401/403/429) stops the whole read.
